Where do these headlines come from?

When demo mode is switched off, the dashboard attempts to fetch live headlines through the keyless GDELT 2.1 news API. If that attempt fails — network error, blocked response or disabled flag — it falls back to bundled demonstration headlines, and every panel keeps its data-quality badge. Headlines are provided as-is and are not verified reporting.

HORMUZ WATCH

An open shipping-intelligence dashboard for the Strait of Hormuz — vessel activity, energy markets, insurance signals and regional analysis in one place.

Data notice: unless a panel is marked LIVE, all figures are simulated demonstration data. Never use this site for trading, navigation or safety-critical decisions.
